_doc: Copy for tools/marketing/compose.py, from docs/distribution/marketing/copy.md (step 122). Callout rects: names from tmp/marketing/raw/meta.json or [x, y, w, h] in raw 1920 x 1080 window pixels (top-down).

screens.name: hotbox
screens.title: The hotbox, under the space bar
screens.line: Hold Space for every menu of the current menu set.

screens.name: marking_menus
screens.title: Right-click marking menus
screens.line: Object and component menus in Maya's radial positions, with gestures.

screens.name: channel_box_ae
screens.title: Channel Box and Attribute Editor
screens.line: Type +=5, see keyed channels in red, browse node tabs.

screens.name: menus_shelves
screens.title: Menu sets, shelves, option boxes
screens.line: F2–F6 menu sets, factory shelves, option windows with Maya's defaults.

screens.name: navigate_select
screens.title: Navigate and select the Maya way
screens.line: Alt + mouse to tumble, QWERTY tools, F8 components, Maya selection colors.

screens.name: pivot_snapping
screens.title: Pivots and snapping you know
screens.line: Hold D to edit the pivot; hold X, C or V to snap.

screens.name: animation
screens.title: Time Slider and Graph Editor
screens.line: Key ticks, Range Slider, Maya tangents and Auto Key.

screens.name: rigging
screens.title: Joints, IK and skin weights
screens.line: Joint Tool, IK handles, Bind Skin and Paint Skin Weights.

screens.name: modeling_toolkit
screens.title: Modeling Toolkit, docked
screens.line: Multi-component selection and the mesh tools in one panel.

screens.name: switch_before
screens.title: Nothing changes until you choose
screens.line: Click Blender in the switch and everything Allset changed comes back.

clips.name: hotbox
clips.title: The hotbox, under the space bar
clips.caption: Tap Space to toggle one view and four views; hold Space for the hotbox with every menu of every menu set. Here: Select > All, straight from the hotbox.

clips.name: marking_menu
clips.title: Right-click marking menus
clips.caption: Right-click over an object for its marking menu in Maya's positions: drag to Vertex for component mode, right-click again for Object Mode.

clips.name: channel_box_keys
clips.title: Key it in the Channel Box
clips.caption: S keys every channel and the Channel Box turns red; type +=90 into Rotate Z, right-click > Key Selected keys only that channel, then scrub the Time Slider.

clips.name: navigation
clips.title: Navigate the Maya way
clips.caption: Alt + left drag tumbles, Alt + middle drag tracks, Alt + right drag dollies; click an object and press F to frame it, A to frame everything.

clips.name: pivot_snap
clips.title: Edit the pivot, snap with V
clips.caption: Insert edits the pivot; hold V while dragging and it snaps to a vertex of the drill. Insert again, and the drill rotates around its new pivot.

clips.name: rigging
clips.title: Joints, IK and skin weights
clips.caption: From the Rigging shelf: Create Joints by clicking, an IK Handle from shoulder to wrist, Bind Skin, pull the handle, then Paint Skin Weights.

clips.name: switch
clips.title: Maya or Blender, one click
clips.caption: One click on Blender in the top-bar switch gives plain Blender back with the same scene; one click on Maya brings the Maya layout, keys and colors back.

trailer.end_headline: The tutorial ends. Your Channel Box comes back.
